hardware.variant: Luckfox Lyra Zero W, RK3506B, populated USB radio

inputs.name: EmberBSD evbarm GENERIC kernel ELF on FFS
EmberBSD multi-user FFS root
inputs.revision: earmv7hf with the BSD ifconfig wireless commands

scenario: Keep the previous kernel pair. Rename the staged ELF to /netbsd on FFS and the staged uImage to netbsd-GENERIC.ub on FAT. Remount FAT read-only and verify the installed and previous pairs by SHA-256. Run /sbin/shutdown -r now from the serial shell. Let U-Boot run /boot.scr from microSD. At the local root console, run ifconfig -l, ifconfig aicwf0 up, ifconfig aicwf0 list scan and ifconfig aicwf0. Test SSH public-key login from a host through a UART relay to the board loopback interface.
expected: The station appears in the interface list and comes up. A scan result for an access point would confirm radio reception.
observed: The shutdown service saved entropy. U-Boot ran /boot.scr and read the 11308316-byte kernel image from microSD. The kernel mounted dk1 as FFS and attached aicwf0 at uaicfw0. The system restored entropy before starting sshd. The interface list included aicwf0. Bringing it up succeeded. The scan exited with status 0 and printed zero rows. The interface reported status: no network. The host verified the SSH host key and completed public-key login through the UART relay.
limits: One software reboot from the installed microSD. The PCB revision is unknown. A separate UART RAM boot also brought up aicwf0 and returned zero scan rows.
Neither receive-only kernel reported the firmware station creation status. The scan command can print cached results if the request for a new scan fails.

The radio showed no association. Beacon reception and a DHCP lease remain unverified. The UART relay exercised the local SSH service. A separate SSH attempt from the host stopped during name resolution.
